cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I Know How to Fix Us
cards.instruction: Perform confidence about repairing the relationship while improvising every step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. We can fix last night's shouting. Tea first, then one honest sentence each.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want tea. I want you to listen without interrupting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Of course. Listening stage. I'll write down anything I want to interrupt with.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll be writing instead of listening.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you keep the pen. Supervised listening. If I interrupt, write it down; we'll start with that.

mechanism: A professionally names and revises repair procedures in response to B objections, improvising a listening plan while maintaining confident expertise.
confusable: D89 reframes a past break as healthy; D90 displays live improvised repair steps presented as a confident method.
comparison: Biscuit alternative will improvise restitution after a missing-snack grievance; listening alternative gives B control of the pen when A note plan is challenged.
seedUse: Last-night shouting, rejected tea, notes and B holding pen derive from D90-a; S03 adds exact procedure corrections and concrete listening controls.
